claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface has object attachment and consumable activation scaffolding, but it still lacks the core deterministic effect: creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects that prevents separation until a closed set of counters breaks it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: delayed_settlement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The glue does not create its permanent state immediately on application. The authored surface lacks a way for a magic-item activation to apply an effect after a 1-minute setting window and then persist until explicitly broken.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set.
